scope: Eight priority destinations; limited roof, footprint, campus and selected official-photo review. This is not an audit of all mapped POIs.
imageryHandling: Reference links and factual observations only. No third-party imagery is redistributed as app assets or textures.
limitations: Aerial acquisition dates are not verified.
Visible roof shapes do not establish heights, precise doors, accessibility, facade materials or current tenant boundaries.
General city buildings remain source-footprint extrusions rather than inspected photorealistic replicas.

records.name: Cactus Jack’s Family Fun Center
observations: A narrow, light-colored roof runs north–south west of Council Road, with several small projections along its west edge.
Paved customer parking lies between the east side of the building and Council Road; a separate roof lies southwest.
The city footprint shape and orientation correspond to the observed roof. Exterior wall materials, signage dimensions and entrance position were not established.

records.name: Yukon Christmas in the Park
observations: The inspected park aerial shows a pond, paths, curving park drives, courts, recreational buildings and parking within a broader park system.
The official event photo shows illuminated figures and colorful ground light displays at night; it does not provide surveyed positions or a year-specific installation layout.
This is a seasonal park destination, not a single building. Festive objects should remain illustrative and not be labeled exact replicas.
